en.hook: $0.68 a mile for Class A drivers
en.body: You drive, you get paid by the mile: $0.68 for every one. If you hold a Class A license, we want to talk with you.

es.body: Manejas y cobras por milla: $0.68 por cada una. Si tienes tu licencia Clase A, queremos hablar contigo.

en.body: Straight talk: the rate is $0.68 per mile. Call us, ask your questions, and hear how the runs work before you decide.

es.body: Sin rodeos: pagamos $0.68 por milla. Llámanos, haz tus preguntas y conoce cómo van las rutas antes de decidir.
